player_prompt.intro:
Ati Blackjack diilaarii wajjin taphatte.
Mee ati garmi 21 taa'u qaba, garuu 21 ol ta'ee hin qabu.
Tapha kee, '[Hit]' fayyadamu gartuu biraa fudhachuuf ykn '[Stand]' fayyadamu garmi itti fufu.
J/Q/K = 10 point; A = 11 ykn 1, kan ati fayyaa ta'e.
